2026-11-28.note: Claude's proposal: make your Saturday version the new Legs B (leg press, feet-high leg press, leg curl, seated calf raise); say keep it and the plan changes.

pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Same 15 kg dumbbells, aim for 6: you got 5 and 5 last time after a short night; if 5 again, drop to 12.5 kg.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Stay at 10 kg and go past 8: you got 8 on every set, now push to 1 rep before failure.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg, no pin: the next setting is 10 kg, which gave only 7 a side. Go to failure, slow on the way down.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Stay at 30 kg: the second set fell to 8, so get 12 on both before going up.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Stay at 25 kg and go past 10 on every set, to failure.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Stay at 4 kg: you got 15 on every set, now go to failure, aim for 18.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Stay at 37.5 kg: you got 8 on every set, aim for 10 before going up.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Up one step to 25 kg: every set reached 12 at 20 kg.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Stay at 20 kg: you got 14 on every set, one rep from the step up.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Stay at 10 kg: 12 on every set is the bottom of 12 to 20, so go to failure.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg, no pin: you got 16 a side, go to failure and aim for 18.

pullA:curl.coach: Stay at 5 kg: you got 10 on every set, aim for 12 before going up.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Up one step to 20 kg: every set reached 12 at 10 kg on Saturday.

legsA:rdl.coach: Up one step to 25 kg on the cable: every set reached 10 at 20 kg.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg: you got 14 on every set, one rep from the step up.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Stay at 10 kg, slow: you got 12 on both sets, go to failure now.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Stay at 20 kg: you got 12 on every set, go to failure and aim for 15.

pushB:incline-press.coach: Up one step to 15 kg: 12 on every set is past the top of 6 to 10.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Up one step to 15 kg: every set reached 12 at 12.5 kg.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Stay at 4 kg: you got 15 on every set, go to failure and aim for 18.

pushB:dips.coach: Stay at 30 kg: 8 on every set is the bottom of 8 to 12, so aim for 10.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: Stay at 15 kg: you got 12 on every set, go to failure and aim for 15.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg, no pin: you got 16 a side, go to failure and aim for 18.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: Up one step to 25 kg: 12 on every set at 20 kg. If 12 comes easily, take 30 kg on the next set.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: Wide-grip cable row again, up one step to 25 kg: every set reached 12. Hands as hooks, pull with the elbows.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: Up one step to 15 kg: every set reached 12 on both sides.

pullB:face-pull.coach: Stay at 10 kg: 12 is under 15 to 20, so go to failure and aim for 15.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: Stay at 5 kg, no pin: you got 16 a side, go to failure and aim for 18.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: Stay at 8 kg: you got 12 on every set, go to failure and aim for 15.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: pick dumbbells you can hold for 10 a leg with 1 rep left. If you swap to the leg press again, use Wednesday's weight.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: pick a weight you can push for 10 with 1 rep left. If you take the feet-high leg press again, go one plate above 12.5 kg.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg: you got 14 on every set, one rep from the step up.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: Up one step to 20 kg: every set reached 20 at 15 kg.
